newsitem.title: FRANCE: Globe Air appointed French GSA for Avianca.
newsitem.headline: Globe Air appointed French GSA for Avianca.

text.p: French cargo sales agent, Globe Air Cargo, said it had been appointed French cargo sales agent, for Colombian airline, Avianca, effective December 1.

"Avianca's three-times weekly Paris-Bogota Boeing 767 passenger service offers about ten tonnes of cargo capacity per week and in addition it has a block space agreement on Air France's twice-weekly Boeing 747-200F service on the route representing approximately 20 tonnes," Globe Air President, Guy Tordjman, told Reuters.
Avianca was previously represented in France by cargo agent, Transport Assistance Service (TAS), Tordjman said.

The agreement with Avianca would enable Globe Air to reinforce its position in Bogota where it had developed an air cargo hub and spoke system for Central and Latin America via its cargo sales office in Miami, Tordjman added.

Globe Air's airline customers include Air China, Air Malta, Biman Bangla Desh, COPA, Ethiopian Airlines, Royal Nepal Airlines, USAir U.N. and Vietnam Airlines. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
